name: sveltekit-3-sourcemaps
description: E2E test app asserting what the SvelteKit SDK uploads to Sentry and what it leaves behind in `build`.

scripts.build: node start-mock-sentry-server.mjs & vite build > .tmp_build_stdout 2> .tmp_build_stderr; BUILD_EXIT=$?; kill %1 2>/dev/null; if [ $BUILD_EXIT -ne 0 ]; then cat .tmp_build_stdout; cat .tmp_build_stderr >&2; fi; exit $BUILD_EXIT
